title: Shaft speed ambiguous — no conclusive kinematic identification
summary: Generic model: MAP 3404.96 rpm, p_map=0.434 (<0.8), 68% CI 3399.7-3410.2 rpm, with alternatives 5681.9 rpm p=0.276, 4262.0 rpm p=0.144 and 1134.1 rpm p=0.146 (1/3x relation); explained 11/18 peaks. Tracked speed_hz_now 19.043 Hz = 1142.6 rpm conflicts with MAP and matches the 1134 rpm mode. What-if 4-pole induction: 1481.9 rpm p=0.526 vs 1408.6 rpm p=0.474, explained 14/18 (best), still bimodal. 2-pole: p_map=1.0 but only 9/18 explained, prior-driven. display_rpm null, so no independent check/error available. fps 50.0, Nyquist 25.0 Hz, near_nyquist_warning=true. Do not use MAP speed for orders or optimisation until tach/strobe/nameplate confirms it.

title: Amplitudes uncalibrated — no ISO 20816 zone/severity claim
summary: scale_calibrated=false and overall iso_zone=null. Relative channel levels only: s1 upper steel frame 2.364 mm/s RMS vs s2 side metal casing 1.333 mm/s RMS (ratio 1.77) must NOT be reported as ISO zones C/B or absolute severity. Conclusions restricted to frequencies, orders, phase and ratios. 1x relative order 0.559 mm/s, 2x/3x 0.0, is also not usable diagnostically while shaft speed is ambiguous and 2x of 19.04 Hz would exceed 25 Hz Nyquist.

summary: Evaluable posteriors (generic): resonance P=0.030 (forcing-to-mode separation 7.546, -6.5 dB), campbell_criticals=[]; looseness P=0.026, range 0.004-0.051 (4 harmonics above 10 dB, -2.4 dB; half-order 2.3 dB, -4.3 dB); cavitation P=0.009, cavitation index 0.061 (-10.0 dB), HF energy fraction 0.0147, HF kurtosis 0.015, audio cavitation_like=false, rubbing_or_impacts=false. title: Imbalance, misalignment and other major faults not evaluable from this capture
summary: evaluable=false, posterior=prior for: imbalance P=0.15, misalignment P=0.10, flow/blade-pass P=0.10, combustion P=0.10, bearing P=0.08, rotor_bar P=0.05. Therefore 1x-dominant/radial imbalance and 2x with ~180 deg across-coupling misalignment rules cannot be applied, and no balance or fault work order is supported. text:
## Assessment — identification inconclusive; optimisation withheld

**Speed / kinematics unresolved (warn).** Under the read model (generic):
- MAP **3405 rpm, p=0.434**, 68% CI 3399.7–3410.2 rpm, with competing modes at **5682 rpm (p=0.276)**, **4262 rpm (p=0.144)** and **1134 rpm (p=0.146, ⅓×)**; only **11/18 peaks explained**.
- The tracked speed, **19.04 Hz = 1143 rpm**, instead matches the 1134 rpm minor mode. `display_rpm` was null, so there is no independent check.
- What‑ifs did not resolve it: **4‑pole induction** explained the most peaks (**14/18**) but split bimodally between **1482 rpm (p=0.526)** and **1409 rpm (p=0.474)**; **2‑pole** gave p=1.0 but explained only **9/18** (prior‑driven — not credible). I reverted to the original generic model.

**Amplitude scale invalid for severity.** `scale_calibrated=false`, overall `iso_zone=null`. The channel values (frame 2.36 mm/s vs casing 1.33 mm/s RMS, ratio 1.77) are **relative only** — no ISO 20816 zone or absolute mm/s severity is claimed. Capture at 50 fps gives Nyquist **25.0 Hz** with a near‑Nyquist warning; the 1× relative order was 0.559 with 2×/3× = 0, which is uninterpretable until shaft speed is confirmed.

**Structural modes (usable frequency evidence).** FDD modes at **3.125 Hz** (ζ=0.129, sv_ratio 5.07, phase −19.6°) and **6.641 Hz** (ζ=0.049, sv_ratio 10.04, phase +30.1°) between upper steel frame and side casing; residual peak **2.344 ± 0.195 Hz** (no damping). Damping has no reported error bars — treat as indicative.

**Faults:**
- Evaluable (generic): resonance **P=0.030** (separation ratio 7.55, −6.5 dB; `campbell_criticals=[]`), looseness **P=0.026**, cavitation **P=0.009** (index 0.061, HF fraction 0.0147; audio: no cavitation or rubbing/impacts). No skip bands justified.
- **Not evaluable** (`evaluable=false`, posterior = prior): imbalance 0.15, misalignment 0.10, blade‑pass/flow 0.10, combustion 0.10, bearing 0.08, rotor‑bar 0.05. The imbalance (1× radial) and misalignment (2×, ~180° across coupling) rules therefore cannot be applied — **no balance or fault work order is supported**.
- Note: resonance is hypothesis‑sensitive (fan what‑if gave P range 0.03–0.71), so it cannot be fully excluded until machine class/speed are confirmed.

## Optimisation decision

**Not run.** `run_optimiser` / `propose_setpoint` were deliberately not executed: the digital twin would be built on an unconfirmed shaft speed (MAP vs tracked speed conflict by ~3×), an uncalibrated scale, and a 25 Hz Nyquist. The record shows steady speed (`speed_changing: steady`), and variable‑speed operation is unconfirmed — there is no valid basis for a setpoint, skip bands, or energy/impact (kWh, cost, CO₂) figures, and none are invented here.

**Action queued (followup, id a1b7ab, due 2027‑02‑02):** re‑capture before any optimisation with — tach/strobe or a legible display‑rpm photo; nameplate/machine‑class photo (poles, blades/vanes); calibrated triaxial accelerometers at both bearing housings (radial + axial, cross‑coupling phase); and sampling that resolves 1×–3× unaliased (≈ >380 samples/s if the 5682 rpm candidate is real). Then re‑run identification, and only if variable‑speed operation is confirmed, run the optimiser with resonance‑margin and duty constraints.
